This product has a thick, gel-like consistency, but it absorbs quickly. The gel is tightening and firming and is not highly perfumed. I recommend using this after cleansing and toning, as it does not sit well over other skincare products.

I have been using the SkinChemists Youth Series for a few weeks now, and I can see a difference. I started with the eye serum, which contains 2% collagen, and I love how lightweight it feels. It absorbs quickly, does not irritate my skin, and has really helped reduce puffiness and smooth out my under-eye area. I also tried the collagen facial serum, and my skin looks firmer, fresher, and more glowy. The results did not happen overnight, but they are consistent, and my skin just feels healthier. What I really appreciate is that these formulas are designed for sensitive skin and early signs of aging. Additionally, the packaging feels very luxurious. The products have a lightweight texture, no harsh fragrance, and are perfect for everyday skincare routines. I would absolutely repurchase these products, especially the eye serum, as it has become a staple in my nighttime routine.

reserve: Only six reviews are available, so conclusions by skin type and concern rest on very limited testimony.
